value.title: Reconnect, key refresh, runtime continuity, and live proof
value.summary: Implement plan 124 serially as u1 then u2, prove the real-client restart contract, and close through cross-model review.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: RED-first extension tests precede each implementation. Prime grants the daemon restart window; reviewer is Claude Opus.

value.title: Add RED-first daemon client tests for reconnect cursors, refusal fallback, key rotation, bounded retry, and backoff.
Implement the supervised reconnecting daemon event client and transparent key refresh without daemon changes.
Add RED-first runtime restart tests for notices, seat continuity, replayed injection, and one inbox acknowledgement.
Wire runtime re-attach through existing pushedChain and consumePushed, preserving the same seat id and pane.
Run focused tests, typecheck, harness checks, then the prime-granted hand-started omp daemon-restart proof and capture evidence.
Complete Claude Opus review, resolve findings, close ddoc evidence, post-flight, archive, and ship through governed gates.

tk-1241.assertion: Every new client case is witnessed failing on the pre-fix implementation and the RED output is retained in the done report.

tk-1242.assertion: Client reconnects with the complete per-alias cursor map, falls back live-only on cursor refusal with the daemon reason, refreshes the key before attach, retries any 401/403 once, and caps jittered backoff at 5s.

tk-1243.assertion: Runtime restart case fails before the fix and then proves one inline injection, one inbox acknowledgement, reconnect notices, and same-id seat re-registration.

tk-1244.assertion: All replayed message.pushed frames use the existing pushedChain and consumePushed path; no second injection or acknowledgement path exists.

tk-1245.assertion: Focused vitest, just typecheck, and harness checks are green; after prime replies GRANTED, a hand-started omp survives the restart, receives the body inline, shows pushed to inbox-ack with no pointer, and pij_send succeeds.

tk-1246.assertion: Claude Opus review verdict is recorded, findings are fixed or evidence-refuted, every AC carries a receipt, post-flight archives the plan, and ship opens the governed PR.
